title: A run's result file
description: The one result every run writes: <agent>.json (or <job>.json) in the results folder. verdict and text always; count and notify optional, for every job. The event ha_claude_result carries count as 0 when the result has none, and a missing notify is false; notify counts only for a job with a notify condition. A schema cannot say, and the add-on's check keeps: one JSON value and no more, the limits counted in characters after the control characters are removed, a count written as a plain whole number, and a result newer than its run.
